regions.merged_text: The following pages with the books that preceed this, would seem to offer an example of supreme asceticism . As iron in fire is imbued with the nature of the fire, so in a maner is Mary the Virgin Mother of God impued, en- livened, with the divine nature To know her too means to appreciate and to love -- both her and her Divine Son. Praised forever be God in His Works! -- and in His Master- piece of all masterpieces. His own Immaculate Mother Mary and Virgin!
